comparison.objective: Select a wrench, loosen a captive latch nut, and open the released arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Clearance-sensitive wrench fitting, nut loosening, and articulated latch release without rounding hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Latch is released, arm opens, and a hands-free hold is demonstrated.
comparison.reason: This is single-nut latch release and opening, whereas the candidate must preserve a screw-defined angle while tightening a separate jam nut and then cycle the mechanism. Detailed tier thresholds are missing, but the tested mechanisms differ.
